blockingIssues.description: The focused native <select> path is still over-broad: the dashboard Escape handler can intercept Escape for selects, which risks stealing the first Escape from the browser's native select popup instead of letting native dismissal happen first.

The follow-up fix exempts focused native <select> elements from dashboard unwind entirely, which preserves the first Escape for native dismissal but breaks the broader unwind contract while focus remains on the select.

The updated regression test encodes the incomplete behavior by allowing the filter panel to remain open after Escape on the focused select and only closing it on a later Escape, rather than proving that dashboard unwind resumes appropriately after native dismissal.

rejectedObservations.observation: Later fixup milestones (`leadership-ui-fixups-2`, `-3`, and `-4`) contain the follow-on native-select Escape corrections, so there are no new completed implementation features to review inside the original `leadership-ui-fixups` milestone itself during this rerun.
